posts.headline: X 1.6.0 is in your Drive: X-1.6.0-portable.exe. Click the new Grok button at the top, press Ctrl+G, or tap…
posts.text:
X 1.6.0 is in your Drive: [X-1.6.0-portable.exe](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_khlf0T39DmgajYiXMv8t3oOhsqKjlQ3/view?usp=drivesdk). Click the new Grok button at the top, press `Ctrl+G`, or tap Grok in the bottom bar, and a Grok chat slides open on the right while X stays on the left. It uses your X login, so there's no key to set up. You can drag the panel wider, pop it out into its own window, or switch it to http://Grok.com. To ask about something, right-click a post or text you've highlighted, choose **Ask Grok about this**, then paste it into Grok with `Ctrl+V`.

The new **Black, White & America** theme is in the gear menu. It's black with white text, flag red and blue, a red, white and blue stripe at the top and bottom, and a star on the + button. I tested both while logged out, so let me know how Grok works once you're signed in.

posts.headline: X 1.5.0 is in your Drive: X-1.5.0-portable.exe. It now has a phone-style tab bar along the bottom for Home…
posts.text:

It now has a phone-style tab bar along the bottom for Home, Search, Grok, Notifications, Messages, and Profile, with red badges. I tested it while logged out, so let me know if anything looks off on your timeline after you sign in.

posts.headline: The X app with update notices (version 1.1.0) is ready: X-1.1.0-portable.exe. It's in your X App folder, so…
posts.text:
The X app with update notices (version 1.1.0) is ready: [X-1.1.0-portable.exe](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GxLq0jX7f3zr_xQaSTVXW7PHiYDg_81P/view?usp=drivesdk). It's in your X App folder, so download it and use it in place of the old one. The 1.0.0 file is still in the folder in case you want it, and you can delete it.

Each time you open the app, it checks the version note, and it checks again every 6 hours while it's open. If there's a newer version, a popup with a **Download** button opens your X App folder. You can also press `Ctrl+Shift+U` to check whenever you want.

The update check won't work until you set that note to **Anyone with the link** as Viewer. I just checked and it's still private. Until then the app works normally but stays quiet about updates. When I make a future version, I'll put it in the folder and change the number in the note, and your app will pop up the notice. update

posts.headline: Your X app for Windows is built, and it's in your Google Drive: X-1.0.0-portable.exe. I couldn't connect to…
posts.text:
Your X app for Windows is built, and it's in your Google Drive: [X-1.0.0-portable.exe](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ThdNpRyl9bvMBbNwAeu-5Eozp-RFr4BU/view?usp=drivesdk). I couldn't connect to your PC to drop it on the Desktop, and the file is about 95 MB, which is too big to attach here, so I put it in Drive.

Download it on your PC and double-click it. Nothing needs to be installed. Since the app isn't signed, Windows will probably show a "Windows protected your PC" warning; click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Google Drive may warn you about downloading an .exe too, so just choose to download it anyway.

It opens http://x.com in its own window with a white X icon. You sign in once and it remembers you. Links to anything outside X open in your normal browser. It takes a few seconds to start each time because it unpacks itself first. To pin it, right-click the running app on your taskbar and choose **Pin to taskbar**. I've only tested it on my computer, not on Windows, so let me know if anything looks off.
